subject: Dashboard is extremely slow to load
description: Our main dashboard takes 30+ seconds to render every morning.
resolution: A saved view was loading too many widgets; split it into focused dashboards and load time dropped under 3s.

subject: Need to export only selected columns
description: The export includes every field but I only want a few specific columns.
resolution: Showed the user how to configure a custom export template selecting just the needed columns.

subject: Discount code not applied at checkout
description: I entered our promo code but the price didn't change on the payment page.
resolution: Code was case-sensitive and had a typo; applied the correct code and the discount reflected immediately.

subject: High latency only during peak hours
description: Between 9 and 11 AM the app is noticeably slower than the rest of the day.
resolution: Peak-hour load was saturating a shared queue; scaled the workers and peak latency normalized.

subject: Charged twice this month
description: It looks like our company was billed two times for the same subscription period.
resolution: A duplicate charge occurred from a failed-then-retried payment; refunded the extra amount within 5-7 business days.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
description: It would be great to have a dark theme for late-night work sessions.
resolution: Logged the request with the product team and shared the public roadmap link for updates.

subject: How do I upgrade to the Business plan
description: We want to move from the Starter plan to Business but I'm not sure where to do it.
resolution: Walked the user through Settings > Plan > Upgrade; proration applied automatically to the new tier.

subject: API returns 401 unauthorized
description: All my API calls suddenly fail with a 401 even though nothing changed in my code.
resolution: The API key had been rotated by an admin; generated a new key and updated the integration's credentials.

subject: App feels laggy on older browser
description: Everything is sluggish for one of our users on an outdated browser version.
resolution: Browser was several major versions behind; updating it restored normal performance.

subject: Search takes too long to return results
description: Global search results take ages to appear for our large workspace.
resolution: Re-indexed the workspace search and enabled the new search backend, cutting latency significantly.

subject: Remove a former employee's access
description: An employee left the company and I need to revoke their account immediately.
resolution: Deactivated the user and reassigned their owned items to a manager to preserve the data.

subject: Can I automate a daily data export
description: I'd like our data emailed as a file automatically every morning.
resolution: Configured a scheduled export with daily frequency delivering to the team distribution list.

subject: Bulk import is very slow
description: Importing a large CSV of records crawls and sometimes stalls.
resolution: Recommended splitting the file into smaller batches and using the async import option, which completed reliably.

subject: Payment failed but card is valid
description: Our monthly charge failed even though the credit card has plenty of funds.
resolution: Issuing bank flagged the recurring charge; user contacted the bank to approve it and we retried successfully.

subject: Can't log in after password reset
description: I requested a password reset link, set a new password, but the login page keeps saying invalid credentials.
resolution: Reset link had expired; issued a fresh link and confirmed the new password worked. Advised links expire in 30 minutes.

subject: Bulk invite multiple users
description: I have a list of 20 people to add and doing them one by one is painful.
resolution: Used the bulk invite by uploading a CSV of email addresses in Members > Invite > Bulk.

subject: Where do I find my API key
description: I'm setting up an integration and can't locate where to generate an API token.
resolution: Directed the user to Settings > Developer > API Keys to create a token with the right scopes.

subject: Cancel subscription before renewal
description: I want to stop our plan from renewing next month and avoid being charged again.
resolution: Cancelled auto-renew from the billing portal; confirmed access continues until the end of the paid period.

subject: API documentation pagination unclear
description: I can't figure out how to page through more than 100 results from the list endpoint.
resolution: Explained the cursor-based pagination using the next_cursor field; user retrieved all pages.

subject: Need to make someone an admin
description: How do I give a teammate full administrator rights?
resolution: Walked the owner through Members > Role > Admin to elevate the teammate's permissions.

subject: Change workspace owner
description: Our current owner is leaving and we need to transfer ownership.
resolution: Transferred ownership from Settings > General > Transfer Ownership after confirming the new owner.

subject: Zapier connection keeps failing
description: My Zap can't authenticate with your service and errors out on every run.
resolution: Account was on a plan without API access; upgraded the plan and the Zapier auth completed.

subject: How do I rename my workspace
description: I want to change our workspace name to match a rebrand.
resolution: Showed the user Settings > General > Workspace Name to rename it.

subject: New employee can't access the login page
description: Our new hire's invite link says the account is not active when they try to sign in.
resolution: Invite had not been accepted; resent the activation email and the account became active after confirmation.

subject: Export button is greyed out
description: The export option is disabled and I can't click it.
resolution: User's role lacked export permission; an admin granted the export right and the button became active.

subject: Webhook events not being delivered
description: Our endpoint is no longer receiving webhook notifications for new records.
resolution: Webhook URL was returning 500s and got auto-disabled; fixed the endpoint and re-enabled the subscription.

subject: Scheduled report didn't arrive by email
description: Our weekly scheduled report email never showed up this Monday.
resolution: Schedule owner's account was deactivated, pausing the report; reassigned ownership and it resumed.

subject: MFA code not arriving on phone
description: My two-factor authentication SMS codes are not coming through, so I am locked out of my account.
resolution: SMS delivery was failing for the carrier; switched the user to an authenticator app (TOTP) which resolved it.

subject: Can't add a new team member
description: When I try to invite a colleague it says the invitation can't be sent.
resolution: Workspace had reached its seat limit; freed a seat by removing an inactive user and the invite went through.

subject: Hitting rate limit 429 errors
description: We keep getting 429 Too Many Requests when syncing data through the API.
resolution: Client exceeded the per-minute quota; advised adding exponential backoff and batching requests.

subject: PDF report missing the latest data
description: The PDF I generated doesn't include records added earlier today.
resolution: Report was using a cached snapshot; triggering a manual refresh before export included the new records.

subject: Refund request for unused seats
description: We downgraded but were still charged for seats we no longer use.
resolution: Issued a prorated credit for the unused seats and applied it to the next invoice.

subject: Guest can't see the shared project
description: I shared a project with an external guest but they say it's not visible.
resolution: Guest access was restricted at the workspace level; enabled external sharing and re-shared the project.

subject: Page freezes when filtering big tables
description: When I apply filters on a table with thousands of rows the browser hangs.
resolution: Enabled server-side pagination for large tables which removed the client-side freeze.

subject: Intermittent 504 gateway timeouts
description: We randomly get 504 errors a few times a day when opening projects.
resolution: Traced to a slow third-party data sync; moved that sync to a background job and timeouts stopped.

subject: Session keeps logging me out
description: I get signed out every few minutes and have to log in again repeatedly.
resolution: Browser was blocking third-party cookies; enabling cookies for our domain kept the session alive.

subject: Account locked after failed attempts
description: After a few wrong password tries my account got locked and I can't get back in.
resolution: Account auto-locks after 5 failed attempts for 15 minutes. Manually unlocked it and advised waiting or resetting.

subject: Update the credit card on file
description: Our old company card expired and I need to add the new one for billing.
resolution: Guided the user to Billing > Payment Methods to replace the card; verified the next charge would use it.

subject: CSV export downloads an empty file
description: When I export my data to CSV the downloaded file has headers but no rows.
resolution: Active filter was excluding all records; clearing the filter before export produced the full file.

subject: Seat limit reached unexpectedly
description: It says we're out of seats but I thought we had more available.
resolution: Several deactivated users were still consuming seats; fully removing them released the seats.

subject: Large export keeps failing midway
description: My export of the entire dataset fails partway through with an error.
resolution: Switched the user to the asynchronous export which emails a download link once the large file is ready.

subject: Invalid signature on webhook payload
description: Our verification of the webhook signature header keeps failing.
resolution: Customer was hashing the raw body incorrectly; shared the correct HMAC-SHA256 verification steps.

subject: Cannot enable two-factor authentication
description: The setup screen for 2FA shows an error when I scan the QR code.
resolution: Device clock was out of sync causing TOTP mismatch; syncing the phone time fixed code generation.

subject: Export to Excel breaks special characters
description: Accented and non-English characters look garbled when I open the export in Excel.
resolution: Advised importing the UTF-8 CSV via Excel's Data > From Text with UTF-8 encoding to render characters correctly.

subject: Forgot password email never received
description: I clicked forgot password several times but no email ever shows up in my inbox.
resolution: Reset emails were landing in spam; whitelisted our sending domain and the user received the link.

subject: SSO login redirects back to sign-in
description: When I click Login with SSO it bounces me back to the login screen instead of logging me in.
resolution: The SAML callback URL in the IdP was misconfigured; corrected the ACS URL and SSO login succeeded.

subject: User has wrong access level
description: One of our members can edit things they should only be able to view.
resolution: Adjusted the user's role from Editor to Viewer in Members settings, restricting their permissions.

subject: Reports time out on large date ranges
description: Running a report across a full year just spins and eventually errors.
resolution: Query was scanning too much data; advised narrowing the range and using the pre-aggregated report type.

subject: Need a copy of last month's invoice
description: I can't find the PDF invoice for our previous billing cycle for our accounts team.
resolution: Generated the invoice from Billing > History and emailed the PDF; showed where to self-download future invoices.

subject: Slack integration stopped posting updates
description: Notifications used to post to our Slack channel but they've gone silent.
resolution: The Slack OAuth token had expired; reconnected the integration and test messages posted successfully.
